About Samara Estates

We’re a Bengaluru residential real estate consultancy. We help buyers compare properties and arrange site visits, and work with sellers to present their homes to prospective buyers.

Our Vision

To make residential real estate in Bengaluru more transparent and dependable, so people can make confident decisions about where they live and invest.

Our Mission

To help buyers, sellers, and investors make informed property decisions through personalized advice, clear communication, market data, and responsible use of technology and AI.

Founder

Amrita Chatterjee

Co-Founder & Managing Partner | Samara Estates

An entrepreneur. A mother. A leader. A woman who chose to write her own story.

Some journeys are defined by the opportunities life presents. Others are shaped by the courage to create opportunities where none seem to exist.

For Amrita Chatterjee, life has been a journey of resilience, reinvention, and unwavering determination.

A proud mother to a beautiful daughter who remains her greatest inspiration and the heart of her world, Amrita's journey is about much more than professional success. It is about building a life of independence, dignity, and possibility for herself and for the daughter who inspires her every day.

Having navigated life's challenges with courage, she has embraced the responsibilities of motherhood while pursuing her professional ambitions. Her journey reflects the strength of a woman who has learned to transform adversity into determination and responsibility into purpose.

But Amrita's story is not defined by the challenges she has faced.

It is defined by everything she has built despite them.

With over 20 years of experience across finance, investments, and consultancy, spanning industries including technology, fashion and retail, IT, and professional services, Amrita brings a wealth of business experience and a deeply personal understanding of what financial security and independence truly mean.

From Vision to Impact: The Samara Estates Story

Driven by the belief that real estate deserves greater transparency, accountability, and customer-centricity, Amrita embarked on a new entrepreneurial journey with the founding of Samara Estates.

Her vision was clear: to challenge conventional brokerage practices by combining personalized real estate consultancy with technology, data-driven insights, and the responsible adoption of artificial intelligence.

And the vision quickly began translating into results.

Within just three months of its inception, Samara Estates achieved approximately 25 property deals and established channel partnerships with leading Tier-1 residential real estate developers across Bengaluru.

These early milestones reflect the strength of Amrita's relationship-driven approach, her business acumen, and the confidence customers and industry partners have placed in the young company.

What began as an entrepreneurial vision has quickly evolved into a growing residential real estate consultancy, connecting homebuyers and investors with opportunities across Bengaluru's residential property market.

For Amrita, however, success is measured by more than the number of transactions completed.

It is measured by the relationships built, the confidence earned, and the families who find greater clarity in making one of life's most important financial decisions.

A Mission Beyond Brokerage

Amrita envisions Samara Estates as more than a conventional real estate intermediary.

Her ambition is to build a modern, technology-enabled real estate advisory business where customers benefit from transparent practices, intelligent property recommendations, and guidance that prioritizes their interests.

By combining human relationships with technology and AI-driven innovation, she aims to make property transactions more accessible, informed, and dependable.

Building a Legacy

For Amrita, entrepreneurship is not simply about building a successful business.

It is about demonstrating that courage, independence, and perseverance can create extraordinary possibilities.

As a woman entrepreneur and a mother, she hopes her journey inspires others to believe in their own ability to build, lead, and succeed regardless of where their story began.

She is building more than a company. She is building a legacy that women can look up to with pride.

And through Samara Estates, that legacy is being built one relationship, one investment, and one home at a time.
